title: A protocol for the study of the rumen biohydrogenation of unsaturated fatty acids of lipid supplements mixed with forages using an in vitro approach
protocol: Weigh 500 mg of dried and milled forage into 100 mL plastic tubes as replications.
Seal the tubes with one-hole rubber stoppers and keep them in a test tube rack.
Prepare mixtures of lipids using automatic viscous liquid transfer pipettes and store them under refrigeration.
Pre-warm McDougall buffer at 39 °C in a thermostatic water bath.
Add lipid mixtures to the plastic tubes prepared on the previous day.
Collect at least 50 mL of rumen fluid from a fistulated animal, filtering it through three cheese-cloth layers.
Filter rumen fluid through three layers of cheese cloth before collection.
Mix rumen fluid from three specified regions with McDougall buffer in a ratio of 1:4.
Adjust the pH of the inoculum to 6.8 by bubbling CO2 gas.
Keep the bottle sealed and maintain it at 39°C in a thermostat bath.
Place 100 mL plastic tubes containing forage and lipid mixture in a 39°C thermostat bath for at least 15 minutes before the in vitro assay.
Take a 100 mL tube from the incubation bath and add 50 mL of preheated inoculum using an appropriate measuring cylinder.
Seal the tube with a one-hole rubber stopper and return it to the 39°C thermostat bath.
Repeat this process for other tubes.
Shake the tubes manually every two hours during the in vitro assay.
Remove the plastic tube from the thermostat bath.
Add 500 μl of a 2% w/v HgCl₂ solution to the tube.
Place the tube in an ice bath.
Transfer the content of each tube to a 100 mL glass flask.
Freeze the flask at -60°C.
Cover the flask’s mouth with an absorbent paper tower and adjust it with a rubber band.
Put the flask in a tray of a freezer dryer equipment.
Lyophilize the sample until all water is removed.
Place the lyophilized content in an ultra-freezer at -60°C for fatty acid analysis.
Weight 50 mg of lyophilized incubation system in a 16 x 160 mm screw cap tube.
Add 2148 μl methanol, 990 μl toluene, 66 μl of 99.9% sulfuric acid, and 1000 μl dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO) to the tube.
Seal the tube.
Heat the sealed tube at 80°C for 2 hours in a water bath.
Let the tube equilibrate at room temperature.
Recover the hexane layer (top layer) and transfer it to an Eppendorf Safe-Lock tube.
Evaporate the hexane under a nitrogen flux.
Redissolve the resultant residue in 500 μL of dichloromethane.
Transfer 250 μL of dichloromethane solution to a chromatographic vial with appropriate glass insert, septum, and cap.
Inject the sample into a GC-FID according to specified conditions.
Set detector temperature to 260 °C and injector temperature to 270 °C.
Maintain a split ratio of 30:1.
Inject a volume of 1.0 μL.
Start oven temperature at 140 °C for 5 min, increase by 4 °C/min for 5 min up to 220 °C.
Increase oven temperature at 2.0 °C/min for 10 min to reach 240 °C as final temperature.
